value: 2026-09-11, over every berthed verdict artifact in instance-space: 263 berths carrying 927 criteria. Classifying each criterion's `instrument` by whether a command can be extracted from it: under a CONSERVATIVE classifier (first token is one of a known command list) 312 lead with a runnable command, 66 carry exactly one backticked span, and 549 — 59% — are prose with no command in them at all. Under a LOOSER classifier (first token merely LOOKS like a command) the split is 368 / 64 / 493, so prose is 53%. The classifier moves the number and does not move the finding: on either reading a MAJORITY of the corpus carries nothing to run. Three verbatim prose instruments, so the reader sees the sentence and not a number about it: 'read of skills/sail/SKILL.md after the edit: the act's step number strictly below the PROVED-crossing step, ExitGateRed'; 'the live-fire run at the real chokepoint (sha256 of the target history before/after the refused leg...)'; 'two consecutive green runs each of cairn/base/proofs/test_transitions.py, cairn/chart/proofs/test_chart_verdict.py, and ...'. SECOND MEASUREMENT, and it reshaped the design: `inspect_verdict` at verdict.py:258 builds every check `validate_verdict` gates on, and a read of all of them finds ZERO that execute anything — the door's entire judgement is over the artifact's shape.

The 549 prose instruments ALREADY BERTHED are not backfilled and are not rewritten. A berthed verdict artifact is a record of truth, and rewriting one to satisfy a rule invented after it was written would be exactly the collapse Law 7 forbids. So the corpus stays mixed: everything berthed before this ships is shape-checked only, everything after is run. A reader cannot tell the two apart from the artifact alone until enough of the new kind exist to make the observed-run record the norm — which is the second reading the WATCHME probe takes.
